en_title: Jesse Eisenberg Says He 'Couldn't Get Movie Studio Parts' After Winning His Batman v. Superman Razzie
cn_title: 艾森伯格称金酸莓奖让他难接大片
subtitle: 「行业会告诉你答案」
opus_summary: 杰西·艾森伯格称，凭卢瑟一角获金酸莓奖后，他难以再接到大制片厂角色，因而转向编剧和导演。他认为，若想继续艺术生涯，就必须听取行业反馈，找准受认可的方向。

paragraphs.en: Jesse Eisenberg says he "couldn't get into studio movie parts" because he won a Worst Supporting Actor Razzie for playing Lex Luthor in Batman v. Superman .
paragraphs.cn: 杰西·艾森伯格表示，自己因在《蝙蝠侠大战超人》中饰演莱克斯·卢瑟获得金酸莓奖最差男配角，此后便「接不到大制片厂电影的角色了」。

paragraphs.en: The Social Network star elaborated on what has become one of his most divisive roles when speaking at the BFI London Film Festival (via Variety ). He recalled how his time as a long-haired Lex made landing acting roles more challenging, specifically calling attention to how his Golden Raspberry Award win played a part during a difficult time in his career .
paragraphs.cn: 据《综艺》报道，这位《社交网络》主演在BFI伦敦电影节上，详细谈到了这个堪称他演艺生涯中最具争议的角色之一。他回忆，出演长发版卢瑟后，自己接戏变得更加困难，并特别提到，获得金酸莓奖如何影响了他那段艰难的职业生涯。

paragraphs.en: "Listen, a lot of it just came from fear," he said when describing his shift away from studio roles. "I couldn’t get into movie studio parts anymore because I had won a Raspberry Award from [being in the] Batman movie … and I saw the trajectory."
paragraphs.cn: 谈到自己为何不再出演大制片厂电影时，他说：「说真的，这很大程度上就是出于恐惧。我再也接不到大制片厂电影的角色了，因为我演了那部蝙蝠侠电影，拿了金酸莓奖……我看出了事情的发展方向。」

paragraphs.en: Although the polarizing Batman v. Superman: Dawn of Justice does have its fair share of fans, Eisenberg's more eccentric performance as the Superman villain has remained one of its most controversial elements in the decade since its premiere. His acting was so…memorable that he walked away from the part with a Razzie for Worst Supporting Actor .
paragraphs.cn: 《蝙蝠侠大战超人：正义黎明》虽然评价两极分化，但确实也拥有不少粉丝。然而，自影片首映以来的十年间，艾森伯格对这位超人反派颇为古怪的演绎，始终是片中最具争议的部分之一。他的表演实在太过……令人难忘，以至于凭这个角色拿下了金酸莓奖最差男配角。

paragraphs.en: Winning at the Golden Raspberry Awards, which recognize the worst components in movies each year, isn't usually treated as an honor. No one wants to be told they are the "worst" at anything, and having that Razzie label attached to your name can sometimes even secure a person's place in the hall of filmmaking infamy.
paragraphs.cn: 金酸莓奖每年评选电影中最差的各个部分，获奖通常不算什么荣誉。没人愿意被说成在哪方面是「最差」的，而名字一旦贴上金酸莓奖的标签，有时甚至会让人在电影史上留下恶名。

paragraphs.en: Eisenberg said that's what his experience was after earning a Razzie for Batman v. Superman, and it's why movie fans didn't see him in as many big films in the years that followed. Instead, he learned to pivot to start writing and directing movies. Two projects to come out of that switch-up are 2024's A Real Pain and The Debut, which will premiere this December.
paragraphs.cn: 艾森伯格表示，凭《蝙蝠侠大战超人》获得金酸莓奖后，他经历的正是这种情况。这也是影迷在随后几年里，较少在大片中见到他的原因。他转而学着调整方向，开始编写和执导电影。2024年的《真正的痛苦》，以及将于今年12月首映的《The Debut》，都是这次转型的成果。

paragraphs.en: "If you’re an actor, you’re constantly panicked about 'Am I on an upslope or a downslope?'" he said. "Because there’s no plateau. Acting is just this unstable, awful industry where you are either on the treadmill and you’re doing okay and you’re running up or you are yesterday’s news and it’s awful. And if you’re a paranoid person like me, you see it way in advance."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「如果你是演员，就会一直惶恐不安，担心自己究竟是在走上坡路，还是下坡路。因为根本没有平稳期。表演就是这么一个不稳定、糟糕的行业：你要么还在跑步机上，状态尚可，往上跑；要么就已经过气了，那感觉糟透了。如果你像我一样多疑，就会很早察觉到这一点。」

paragraphs.en: Eisenberg continued: "The industry tells you what they want from you. The industry did not want me to be in a superhero movie, and if you’re smart and self-aware, you learn that quickly. And you know, it's the unsuccessful actor that goes 'No, I want to be in more of those.' It’s not going to happen and they don't want you there and they wouldn't have given you a Raspberry Award if they wanted you there. That's an award for bad acting. And so the industry tells you what it wants and if you want a career in the arts you have to follow the things that you’re being told are liked."
paragraphs.cn: 艾森伯格接着说：「这个行业会告诉你，他们希望你做什么。这个行业不希望我出演超级英雄电影。如果你够聪明，也有自知之明，就会很快明白这一点。你知道，只有不成功的演员才会说，不，我还想多演几部这样的电影。这不会发生，他们不想让你演；如果想让你演，就不会给你颁金酸莓奖了。那可是奖励糟糕演技的奖。所以，这个行业会告诉你它想要什么。如果你想在艺术领域继续职业生涯，就必须沿着别人告诉你受认可的方向走。」

paragraphs.en: Although the ex-Lex Luthor actor, who went on to reprise his role in Justice League, has found his footing in the years since his time in the DCEU, Batman v. Superman still has watchers split all these years later. IGN gave the film 6.8/10 review , saying, "BvS is carried by a brutal Batfleck, but as a whole it offers more philosophical drama than superhero escapism."
paragraphs.cn: 这位前莱克斯·卢瑟扮演者后来曾在《正义联盟》中再次出演该角色。尽管离开DC扩展宇宙后的这些年，他已站稳脚跟，但时至今日，观众对《蝙蝠侠大战超人》的评价依然两极分化。IGN给本片打出了6.8分（满分10分），并评价道：「本·阿弗莱克饰演的凶狠蝙蝠侠撑起了《蝙蝠侠大战超人》，但整体而言，影片更多是在呈现哲学戏剧，而非让观众借超级英雄暂时逃离现实。」
